I feel that not everything can be considered "black or white" when it comes to things that are unknown. Most of these strange topics fall in the "grey" category. Saying this, I prefer to think in terms of probability. Truth can be relative depending on our own limited perspective and knowledge. For example, the idea of intelligent life in our massive universe is highly probable. The chance of highly intelligent life finding our planet is less likely given how expansive our universe is but still probable when looking at it objectively. So sometimes we need to remember to take things "with a grain of salt". In my opinion, I think it is highly probable that we have been visited by other races throughout our history. The same goes for my belief in ghosts/spirits and cryptids. I base this off countless hours of watching videos, reading books, conversations with intelligent people and in some cases personal experiences. I feel that I know more about the unknown than most people just because I have been infatuate with this topic since I was a child. But that doesn't mean I know everything. I find it pretentious to think otherwise. I do my best to see things objectively and I feel that it is important to call out misleading information. Some douchebag dressing up as an alien or bigfoot in order to get YouTube votes tends to discredit other evidence that seem to be much more convincing.

Join me in my journey on Voat for the search of truth in the world of the unexplained.
